description: Counts the lines of one text file in the notes folder. Call it before reading a file, to decide whether to read it whole. Returns the file name, line count, size in bytes and first line. Does not return the file's content and does not read outside notes/.

file.description: File name inside notes/, for example week19.txt. No folders, no leading dash.

largeOutput: The file itself is never returned: only its name (the reference), size and first line cut to 120 characters.

errors.message: file must be a plain name inside notes/; send the name only

errors.wrongCall: a value that looks like an option
errors.message: file must be a plain name inside notes/; send the name only

errors.wrongCall: a file that does not exist
errors.message: file was not found in notes/; list the folder first and send an existing name
counting timed out; retry once, then report the file as too large

answers.resultUsedFor: deciding whether to read the file whole or in parts
answers.likeliestWrongCall: a full path instead of a file name
